exposure: Infants born in different seasons (fall, winter, spring, summer)
finding: Elective caesarean section is associated with increased odds of hospitalization for bronchiolitis in the first 2 years of life, particularly for infants born in the spring and summer months.
mod_finding: This study found that elective cesarean section was associated with increased odds of hospitalization for bronchiolitis in the first 2 years of life.
